prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The invention relates to the field of additive manufacturing, i.e. the manufacture of three-dimensional physical objects by the successive deposition (layering) of polymer materials, and more particularly relates to 3D jet printing techniques. The present method of printing on a 3D jet printer includes the controlled displacement of a 3D printer printing head, the supply of at least two filaments of a fusible material to the printing head, the heating of the filaments by temperature-controlled heaters, the alternate activation of one of the nozzles by means of a printer control module, and the pressurized supply of a filament to the active nozzle. During switching of the nozzles, the printer control module activates a printing head displacement module, which transfers one of the nozzles into an active position. The movement of a movable platform alters the position of the nozzles relative to a valve for the nozzles, closing off the openings of the inactive nozzles and freeing the opening of the active nozzle. Once the movable platform has been completely secured in an active nozzle activation position, the printer continues printing using the active nozzle. The technical result is an increase in the quality of the 3D models produced.

The present method of printing on a 3D jet printer comprises the controlled displacement of a 3D printer print head, the supply of at least two filaments of fusible material to the print head, the heating of the filaments by temperature-controlled heaters, the alternate activation of one of the nozzles by means of a printer control module, and the pressurized supply of a filament to the active nozzle. outputs.L2:
The invention belongs to the area of additive manufacturing, namely the production of three-dimensional physical items through the sequential application of layers of polymer materials, and is especially concerned with 3D jet-printing technology.  

The described printing method for a 3D jet printer involves controlled movement of the printer’s print head, feeding at least two filaments made of meltable material into the print head, and heating those filaments with heaters whose temperature is regulated. A printer control module selectively activates one nozzle at a time, while the corresponding filament is delivered under pressure to the nozzle that is currently in operation.  

When the system changes from one nozzle to another, the printer control module engages a print-head movement module, which places one of the nozzles into the working position. Movement of a movable platform changes the arrangement of the nozzles with respect to a nozzle valve, thereby sealing the outlets of the nozzles that are not in use and opening the outlet of the active nozzle. After the movable platform has been fully fixed in the position for activating the selected nozzle, the printer resumes printing through that nozzle.  

The achieved technical effect is improved quality of the manufactured 3D models.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to the field of additive manufacturing, and more particularly to three-dimensional jet printing in which objects are produced by depositing successive layers of polymer material. In this type of process, a three-dimensional model is built up layer by layer by selectively dispensing molten or softened material from a printing head in accordance with digital control data.

According to the invention, at least two fusible material filaments are supplied to a 3D printer head. These filaments may be made of polymer materials and may have different colors, compositions, mechanical properties, or functional characteristics. Each filament is associated with a respective heating element or heater. The heaters are temperature-controlled so that each filament can be heated to a suitable processing temperature, allowing the material to melt or soften sufficiently for extrusion through a corresponding nozzle.

The printer is operated by a printer control module. This control module is configured to alternately activate one nozzle of the printer head while keeping the other nozzle or nozzles inactive. When a particular nozzle is selected for printing, the control module also pressurizes the supply of filament material associated with that active nozzle. As a result, the molten material is forced through the active nozzle and deposited onto the print surface or onto a previously formed layer of the object.

When switching from one nozzle to another, a displacement module moves the printing head in such a way that the desired nozzle is transferred into an active printing position. This allows the printer to change between different materials or colors during the manufacturing process without interrupting the formation of the object. The displacement may be controlled precisely to ensure that the selected nozzle is correctly aligned with the intended deposition location.

The printing head further includes a movable platform arranged to cooperate with the nozzle openings. This platform closes the openings of inactive nozzles while leaving the opening of the active nozzle free. By sealing inactive nozzles, the platform helps prevent unwanted leakage, dripping, stringing, or contamination between materials. At the same time, it ensures that the active nozzle remains unobstructed and ready for controlled extrusion.

Through the coordinated operation of the temperature-controlled heaters, the printer control module, the displacement module, and the movable platform, the invention enables improved multi-material or multi-color 3D printing. In particular, closing inactive nozzle openings reduces defects caused by residual material flow and improves the dimensional accuracy, surface finish, and overall quality of the produced three-dimensional models.
outputs.L4:
A 3D jet printing method is provided for manufacturing three-dimensional models from fusible printing materials. The method uses a printing apparatus equipped with a print head that can receive at least two different filaments of heated fusible material. Each filament is associated with a corresponding nozzle, and the apparatus includes a control module that coordinates the selection and operation of these nozzles during the printing process.

During printing, the control module switches between the available fusible-material filaments by controlling the displacement of the print head and by moving a nozzle-positioning platform. This platform positions the selected nozzle in an active printing position so that the chosen material can be deposited onto the model being formed. At the same time, nozzles that are not currently selected are moved into an inactive state and are sealed or closed to prevent leakage, dripping, contamination, or unintended deposition of material.

By accurately controlling which nozzle is active and by sealing the inactive nozzles, the system enables reliable switching between different materials, colors, or filament types. This reduces printing defects that can occur when unused nozzles ooze material or when nozzle alignment is imprecise. As a result, the printed layers are deposited more cleanly and accurately, improving the surface finish, dimensional precision, and overall quality of the produced three-dimensional models.

The controlled nozzle-switching mechanism therefore allows a 3D printer to perform multi-material or multi-color printing with greater consistency. It enhances the stability of the printing process, minimizes waste, and helps produce higher-quality 3D objects with fewer imperfections.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for an invention involving a 3D jet printer with multiple filament-fed nozzles, a movable platform for switching the active nozzle, and improved print quality.
counterfactuals.output: A 3D jet printing apparatus includes a plurality of filament-fed print nozzles configured to deposit build material onto a work surface, and a movable nozzle-support platform configured to selectively position one of the plurality of nozzles in an active printing position. Each nozzle may be supplied with a corresponding filament material, enabling rapid selection between different materials, colors, nozzle diameters, or print characteristics without requiring manual replacement of a print head. The platform is movable relative to a print region to shift an inactive nozzle away from the printing position and align a selected nozzle with a deposition path. A controller coordinates filament feed, nozzle heating, material extrusion, and platform movement to maintain accurate registration between nozzle changes. By isolating inactive nozzles from the active deposition zone and precisely positioning the selected nozzle, the apparatus reduces material contamination, stringing, alignment error, and surface defects, thereby improving dimensional accuracy and overall print quality of printed three-dimensional objects.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the invention in formal patent language: a method for additive manufacturing using at least two fusible material filaments, temperature-controlled heaters, alternating nozzle activation, and a valve that closes inactive nozzles.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention relates to a method for additive manufacturing of a three-dimensional article from a plurality of fusible material filaments. The method comprises feeding at least first and second filaments to respective heating zones associated with respective dispensing nozzles, controlling one or more heaters to maintain each filament at a predetermined processing temperature sufficient to render the filament flowable, and selectively activating the nozzles in an alternating manner to deposit material in accordance with build instructions.

During operation, a first nozzle is opened and supplied with molten or softened material while at least a second nozzle is rendered inactive. A valve mechanism associated with the inactive nozzle is actuated to close the inactive nozzle and thereby inhibit leakage, dripping, oozing, or uncontrolled discharge of material. Upon a change in the material to be deposited, the first nozzle is closed and the second nozzle is opened, with the valve mechanism correspondingly preventing discharge from any nozzle not currently selected for deposition.

The method further includes regulating the temperature of the heaters independently or collectively so that each filament is maintained within a selected temperature range during standby and deposition. By alternating nozzle activation and closing inactive nozzles with the valve mechanism, the method enables selective deposition of different fusible materials while reducing cross-contamination, stringing, and material waste, thereby improving dimensional accuracy and surface quality of the manufactured article.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise technical field and method description for a 3D printing patent where the print head switches between nozzles by moving a platform that aligns one nozzle with a valve opening.
counterfactuals.output:
**Technical Field**

The invention relates to additive manufacturing systems, and more particularly to a 3D printing print head having multiple material nozzles selectively coupled to a dispensing valve by moving a nozzle-support platform to align a selected nozzle with a valve opening.

**Method**

A method of operating a multi-nozzle 3D printing print head includes providing a print head having a valve with a valve opening and a platform carrying a plurality of nozzles. The platform is moved relative to the valve to position a selected nozzle in alignment with the valve opening. Once aligned, printing material is supplied through the valve opening and discharged through the selected nozzle onto a build surface. To switch nozzles, material flow is stopped, the platform is repositioned to align a different nozzle with the valve opening, and material is then dispensed through the newly aligned nozzle. The process may be repeated during a print operation to enable selective deposition of different materials, colors, or nozzle sizes.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft an English patent abstract for a 3D jet printing method in which a control module displaces the print head, feeds pressurized filament to an active nozzle, blocks inactive nozzles, and improves model quality.
counterfactuals.output: A 3D jet printing method includes controlling, by a control module, displacement of a print head relative to a printing platform and selectively supplying a pressurized printing filament to an active nozzle of the print head. During printing, the control module causes the active nozzle to jet or extrude the pressurized filament along a predetermined path to form a layer of a three-dimensional model, while one or more inactive nozzles are blocked from receiving or discharging the filament. The inactive nozzles may be sealed, valved, or otherwise isolated to prevent leakage, stringing, unintended deposition, and material contamination. By coordinating print-head movement, filament pressurization, nozzle activation, and nozzle blocking, the method enables accurate material placement, reduces defects between printed regions, and improves surface finish, dimensional precision, and overall quality of the printed three-dimensional model.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following invention idea into a patent-style summary: a multi-nozzle 3D printer supplies heated filaments to a print head, uses a control module to alternate nozzles, and mechanically moves a platform so only the selected nozzle remains open.
counterfactuals.output:
A multi-nozzle three-dimensional printing apparatus includes a print head having a plurality of nozzles configured to receive heated filament material and selectively deposit the filament material to form a printed object. A control module is operatively coupled to the print head and configured to select among the plurality of nozzles during a printing operation, including alternating material deposition between two or more nozzles according to print instructions.

The apparatus further includes a movable platform or actuating member mechanically associated with the nozzles. The platform is configured to move relative to the print head so as to place a selected nozzle in an open or dispensing state while maintaining one or more non-selected nozzles in a closed or blocked state. In operation, heated filament is supplied to the print head, the control module determines which nozzle is to dispense material, and the platform is mechanically repositioned to permit extrusion only through the selected nozzle. This arrangement enables controlled multi-nozzle printing while reducing unintended extrusion from inactive nozzles.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
